releaseNotes: Settings now save instantly - no Save button. Browser Cleaner remembers which items you tick. Application Cleanup covers many more apps (Discord, Slack, Spotify, Teams, VS Code, Chrome, Brave, Adobe Acrobat, Xbox, WhatsApp, Netflix and more). More Windows Cleanup categories (icon cache, internet cache, Remote Desktop cache, PowerShell history). Tray icon right-click now has Open and Exit. Fixes: garbled text on the Windows Cleanup back button, the Application Cleanup detail card no longer needs a checkbox toggle to show files, Registry Care 'Show All' behaves clearly, and the Drive Wiper note is aligned. Plus a tidier Overview.
